retrievalProfile.description: Generates high-contrast black and white male portraits featuring dramatic top-down lighting that emphasizes muscular definition and skin texture against a clean gradient background.
excludeWhen: busy or outdoor backgrounds are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark black and white studio portrait of a male subject from the waist up, utilizing a strong overhead light source to create deep shadows and bright highlights that accentuate anatomical structure. The subject is centered against a light gray background that vignettes into dark corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast creates a halo effect around the head and shoulders
Top-down lighting creates deep shadows in the eye sockets and under the pectoral muscles
Symmetrical composition focuses attention on the central vertical axis of the torso
Monochrome palette emphasizes texture and form over color information
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white tonal range

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally positioned, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist to the top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face and upper chest serve as the primary focal point due to the highest concentration of light and detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the illuminated face, travels down the defined midline of the torso, and is contained by the dark vignettes at the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space exists to the left and right of the head and shoulders, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure black for deep shadows and background edges
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for specular highlights on skin and the center of the background
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and muscle transitions
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from 0 to 100 to maximize dramatic impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a muscular man from the waist up, centered against a light gray background with a dark vignette. Use dramatic overhead lighting to create deep shadows under the brow and muscles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, apply clean sans-serif typography in white or light gray, positioned in the negative space around the head or across the lower third using a 'Multiply' or 'Overlay' blending mode for integration.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the lighting coming from a high angle to define musculature?
Is the subject centered with a clear silhouette?
Is there a visible gradient/vignette in the background?

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the facial features and skin texture
Deep, true blacks in the shadow areas
Clear anatomical definition through light and shadow
avoid: Blown-out highlights that lose skin detail

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical accuracy in the muscle shadows
Ensure the background gradient is smooth without banding
Verify the eyes have appropriate catchlights from the overhead source
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic Monochrome Studio Portrait = (High-Contrast B&W) + (Overhead Key Light) + (Centered Male Torso) + (Vignetted Gradient Background)
